expo-app/src/screens/DashboardScreen.tsx and expo-app/src/screens/ReceiptCaptureScreen.tsx (or any other component that renders images/icons): Ensure every <Image> or icon component that results in a `<div role="img">` in the web build includes an `alt` attribute or `aria-label` via `accessibilityLabel` so the static accessibility test passes.
feedback: All acceptance tests pass, but the static validation fails the accessibility check because image elements lack alternative text. Add appropriate alt/accessible labels to the placeholder images (e.g., on the empty dashboard illustration and receipt capture placeholder) and any other images/icons that render as `<div role="img">` on the web. Once these updates are made, the accessibility test should succeed and the solution can be approved.
